tests: last consumer cancellation forgets the queue and full exchange chain before reconnect
consumer tags are channel scoped and all channels participate in last-consumer tracking
never-consumed queues and never-bound exchanges survive no-op cancellation and unbind
argument-distinct bindings and bindings from other channels retain their source until the last removal
exchange unbinding removes only the auto-delete source, preserving an unbound destination
explicit deletion cascades through a cyclic exchange graph without recursive looping
failed deletion does not erase the desired topology
a pending cross-channel consumer prevents premature auto-deletion before its acknowledgement
a pending binding prevents the last acknowledged unbind from prematurely deleting its source
explicit channel close forgets its last auto-delete consumer but preserves an unused queue
broker cancellation cascades and repeated cancellation cannot resurrect records
server-named queue aliases are removed after cancellation following recovery
consumer acknowledgement immediately followed by broker cancellation cannot leave a stale recovery consumer
scope: Independent wire peer validates desired topology and actual replay, cross-channel pending operations, explicit versus unexpected loss, aliases and failed mutations.
